header.running_head: Obeying the Instructions of Rasulullaah ﷺ

blocks.text: ﷺ was delivering a sermon. "Do sit down," said Rasulullaah ﷺ (during the course of his sermon). Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Rawaaha (RA) immediately sat down where he was outside the Masjid and remained seated there until Rasulullaah ﷺ had completed the sermon. When this was reported to Rasulullaah ﷺ, he said to Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Rawaaha (RA), "May Allaah increase your desire to obey Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ."[^1]

Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) narrates that when Rasulullaah ﷺ sat down on the pulpit one Friday, he said, "Do be seated." Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Rawaaha (RA) heard the instruction of Rasulullaah ﷺ and immediately sat down in the Banu Ghanam district. Someone reported to Rasulullaah ﷺ, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! There is Ibn Rawaaha who sat down where he was when he heard you tell the people to be seated."[^2]
Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) Obeys the Command of Rasulullaah ﷺ

Hadhrat Ataa (RA) reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ was once delivering a sermon when he told the people to be seated. Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) heard this instruction at the door and immediately sat down. Rasulullaah ﷺ then said, "O Abdullaah! You may come inside."[^3]

Hadhrat Jaabir (RA) reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ had just stood up on the pulpit when he told the people to be seated. Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) heard this instruction and immediately sat down at the door of the Masjid. When Rasulullaah ﷺ saw him, he said, "Come in, O Abdullaah bin Mas'ood."[^4]
A Dome is Demolished because Rasulullaah ﷺ Disliked it

Hadhrat Anas (RA) narrates that they were once with Rasulullaah ﷺ when he stepped out. Seeing a large dome, Rasulullaah ﷺ asked, "What is this?" When the Sahabah (RA) informed him that it belonged to one of the Ansaar, Rasulullaah ﷺ remained silent but kept it in mind. When the owner of the dome one day came to greet Rasulullaah ﷺ amongst other people, Rasulullaah ﷺ turned away from him. When this occurred several times, the man realised that Rasulullaah ﷺ was angry and ignoring him. The man brought up the matter with his friends saying, " By Allaah! Rasulullaah ﷺ has behaved strangely today." The others then told him that Rasulullaah ﷺ (was angry with him because he) had seen his dome. The Sahabi (RA) then went out and demolished the dome to the ground.
Ibn Asaakir, as quoted in Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.7 Pg.52). Bayhaqi has reported a similar narration, as quoted in Isaabah (Vol.2 Pg.306).
